example_sentences_in_bangla: তিন লাফে সে দোকানে পৌঁছে গেল।
খবর পেয়ে তিন লাফে বাড়ি ছুটে এল।
example_sentences_in_english: He reached the shop in three leaps.
Upon hearing the news, he rushed home in three leaps.
note: This idiom evokes imagery of rapid animal or human movement, common in oral Bengali folklore.
